rationale: Public autonomous vehicle datasets (COCO, Cityscapes, BDD100k, MTSVD, CeyMo) do not provide explicit 3D median curb/barrier physical height annotations. BusSense utilizes stereoscopic road-plane disparity elevation analysis coupled with local road coordinate longitudinal continuity checking to detect physical dividers and identify missing divider sections.
detection_modality: Stereoscopic 3D Disparity Elevation + Longitudinal Line Continuity
